title: Zaa-ko
text: “Wolf, what were you doing yesterday? You didn’t go to see Iwatani-sama, did you?”
“It was Shion’s turn yesterday. I was out on night patrol, and before that I was studying with Teo—don’t tell me you forgot already, woof?”
Rabbit Guy put a hand to his chin as if mulling over Wolf’s answer.
“So then, I suppose that really was just a dream after all… but, hmm…”
Rafumi’s cover story clearly wasn’t good enough, I say!
“Save the nonsense about me turning into a girl for when you’re actually asleep, Teo.”
“Woof! Turning into a girl!? There’s no need for that at all!”
Hm? Father glanced over at Wolf. What on earth was this guy going on about?
“Itsuki! Naofumi! Motoyasu! Don’t you dare ignore me, you bastards!”

Ren, currently being doted on by Luna-chan, hollered this in the middle of some tug-of-war between Rival’s parent and Assistant. By this point, even Rabbit Guy and Wolf were tuning him out entirely. Just another ordinary day, I say.
“Not sure what caused it, but I’m glad your tail healed, Itsuki.”
“It’s a body part I never even had to begin with, so it makes no difference to me either way.”
“Maybe you’ll be able to spin your tail around and fly now?”
“Naofumi-san, just what exactly do you think I am?”
“Huh? Well, Motoyasu-kun spins his spear around like a helicopter sometimes, so I figured maybe you could do something similar.”
“Please don’t lump me in with that incomprehensible person over there!”

Now that I thought about it, Father had once asked Itsuki—back when he’d turned into a riska—whether he could fly using his tail. Though honestly, what left the strongest impression on me was him flying by shooting flames instead. Come to think of it, I recalled that back in the original world, Father had apparently hoped a Raph-species tail could work like a helicopter rotor too. Big Sister had also been checked to see if she could fly the same way, I say.
“Well, a squirrel’s tail is apparently meant for climbing trees and jumping, so I hope you get the hang of using it properly.”
“Yes, yes. Still… having it suddenly grow back out of nowhere at this point is thoroughly unnatural…”
Even as he said this, Itsuki, while wary about his regrown tail, didn’t dig any deeper into the matter. Well, investigating it would’ve been pointless anyway, I say.
“Ohh? Did your tail heal up?”
Kou noticed Itsuki’s tail and came closer, looking it over from all angles. Watching this, Father kept glancing back and forth between Kou and me.
“Yes, it healed for some reason. Are you satisfied now?”
“That’s great!”
Kou beamed at Itsuki, delighted as if it were his own good fortune. Of course, of course—that’s precisely why I’d gone and healed it for him in the first place.
“…He does seem like a kind sort. If he just keeps growing like this… no, well, I suppose there’s nothing to worry about here…”
“You’ll have to be more careful this time so you don’t get hurt again.”
“Indeed. Though anyone who tries something like that, I’ll skewer without hesitation. Are you after my tail too?”
“Nope, I won’t eat it.”
“So you were considering eating it.”

Itsuki was clearly hostile toward Kou now too. Kou didn’t have the slightest intention of anything of the sort, yet Itsuki was being far too harsh with him. He was every bit as needlessly wary as Father, the one I hadn’t been able to save, I say.
“Ah, but Filo did say Raphtalia-chan’s tail looked tasty, so maybe Kawasumi’s might too?”
“A Filolial through and through, I see. I’ll turn the tables on her if she tries.”
“I’m sure it’ll be fine. Elmelo and Rifana taught her that it’s a no-no.”
Elephant and Big Sister’s friend were the sort who made sure to properly educate Kou. So there was nothing to worry about there, I say.
“Rifana told her that if she really wanted to eat a tail, she should trade for some chicken wings instead—and everybody just shuddered.”

Big Sister’s friend gave a reply eerily reminiscent of Big Sister herself, back when Father—the one I hadn’t been able to save—had been raising her. It was probably a necessary exchange for the sake of educating a proper Filolial-sama, but a terrifying tale nonetheless. Still, it was a far gentler method than provoking Father’s wrath, so I supposed I’d just have to bear with it.
“Oh, but Filo’s been kind of spacey lately, so maybe she wouldn’t even say something like that?”
“Regardless, it’s something to stay wary of. I intend to protect Emia and the others.”
“Yeah. Don’t worry, Kou will protect them too, okay?”
“I’ll leave it to you, then. Whatever else happens, we absolutely must make sure no harm comes to such kind people.”
“Yay! Kou will do his best together with Kawasumi!”
And so, Kou had somehow taken to clinging to Itsuki in the strangest way.
“Hey Itsuki, could you maybe protect me from Luna’s clutches too?”
Ren, still cradled in Luna-chan’s arms, was hollering something or other. Luna-chan, for her part, was simply doting on Ren and Keel.
“Somehow this has gone past ‘lively’ and straight into ‘downright chaotic’ territory…”
“Indeed. I do wonder if the Hero-samas couldn’t manage to be a bit quieter.”
“The Filolials are the real cause of all this, woof.”
“No, it’s Ren and Itsuki making all the racket who are to blame, I say.”
“…Correction. Woof.”

Rabbit Guy and Father wordlessly nodded along to something or other. Honestly, Itsuki and Ren had been far too rowdy since this morning. Just because they were in their fairy-morph forms didn’t excuse being so over-the-top, I say.
“Well then, breakfast’s my job this morning, so I’d better get cooking. Motoyasu-kun, go talk Luna-chan into letting Ren go, would you? Wolf, Teo, take morning roll call for the others, and then—”

And so, with Father’s orders, the morning’s chaos was quickly brought under control, just like that. Since it was Father’s command, after all… though I did have quite a struggle talking Luna-chan into letting go.
Time passed, and it was now sometime past noon.
“Hey, Motoyasu-kun, got a minute?”

Since the show didn’t start until evening, there was still plenty of time left. Everyone was off doing their own tasks or practicing something. It was during this stretch that Father came to fetch me. As for Itsuki, apparently at Father’s suggestion he’d gone off to hunt with Mole and the others out in Zeltoble in the name of leveling up. Yuki-chan, meanwhile, was helping out with practice for the Filolial-samas performing in the circus. Right now it was singing time, together with Elephant. Or perhaps Father had come to sniff out the truth about me being an usaunny. What should I do? Even if it was Father asking, I couldn’t spill the truth until the time was right.
“Yes indeed. What is it, Father?”
“Well, um, I’m not sure if you’ve noticed something, so could you come check it out with me for a sec?”
“Understood.”

Not entirely sure what was going on, I followed along after Father… and there she was! Filo-tan herself! And seated on a rock in front of Filo-tan was none other than Rafumi. Was this Filo-tan the genuine article, or was she actually Rafumi in disguise?
“Za-ko, za-ko?”
“Not enough sneer in it. Add in a little extra ‘ah’ sound.”
“Zaa-ko, zaa-ko?”
“There we go.”
Snap! Rafumi flicked a finger, sending a small piece of chocolate flying toward Filo-tan, who promptly gobbled it right up.
“Yaaay!”
“There, there, keep practicing. This time, try saying it like you’re really looking down your nose at your opponent.”
“Got it! Zaa-ko, zaa~ko!”
“Good, just like that.”
“Just what exactly do you two think you’re doing!”

Of all people to be teaching something so bizarre, it had to be Filo-tan of all people! Sure, I’d been grateful for the help covering things up with Rabbit Guy over last night’s little incident, but what on earth was being taught to Filo-tan now!
“Ah, so you really hadn’t noticed after all, huh. I figured Rafumi-chan had started teaching Filo-chan some weird little trick.”
“Rafumi! What in the world are you teaching Filo-tan!”
